title: Govt mandates scrutiny of 'abnormally low bids', sets 30% threshold
excerpt:
The finance ministry has made it mandatory for government agencies to scrutinise bids quoting prices more than 30 per cent below the estimated cost in a government procurements, tightening checks on abnormally low bids to safeguard service and product quality.
The Department of Expenditure under the ministry has defined Abnormally Low Bids (ALBs) in government procurement, mandating scrutiny of bids falling below the prescribed threshold and seeking written clarifications wherever "concerns" arise over the bidder's ability to execute the contract at the quoted price.

title: FPIs pump ₹84,290 crore into equities in first fortnight of November
excerpt:
Foreign investors made a strong comeback to Indian equities in the first fortnight of November, pumping in Rs 84,290 crore after two consecutive months of net outflows, amid a global AI sell-off, falling crude prices and attractive large-cap valuations.
The latest inflows follow net withdrawals of Rs 34,843 crore in October and Rs 35,861 crore in September, according to data from the depositories.
According to the data, Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) made a net investment of Rs 84,290 crore in Indian equities during November 2-13, covering nine trading sessions.

title: Sebi plans AI guardrails for capital markets, focus on investor protection

Markets regulator Sebi will soon issue detailed guidelines for the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the capital markets, its chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said, emphasising the need to balance technological innovation with investor protection.

title: Emerging-Market Assets Dip as Chip Rout, Fed Rate Worries Linger

ai.why_it_matters_te: విద్యా రంగంలో గ్లోబల్ M&A కార్యకలాపాలు తగ్గడం, ఇండియా ఎడ్యుకేషన్ స్టార్టప్‌లకు పెట్టుబడి ఆసక్తిని తగ్గించవచ్చు.
ai.market_impact_te: ఇండియా ఎడ్యుకేషన్ సెగ్మెంట్‌లో పెట్టుబడి ఆసక్తి తగ్గి, సంబంధిత స్టాక్స్‌లో నెగటివ్ సెంటిమెంట్.
ai.impact_reason_te: బ్లాక్‌స్టోన్ వంటి పెద్ద ఫండ్‌లు విద్యా రంగంలో M&A తగ్గించడం, ఇండియా ఎడ్యుకేషన్ కంపెనీలకు మూలధన ప్రవాహాన్ని పరిమితం చేస్తుంది.
